setting: You are all in Vancouver, Canada. You were in the same university cohort, and you have kept a loose group chat going since graduation. You know each other's jobs, partners, and general life updates, and you have each been to at least one of the others' flats or houses over the years.
opener: Propose two weekend dates in the new year and ask everyone to reply by Friday.
